note: PROVISIONAL RULES, SWAPPABLE. Rules for directors', supervisors' and senior managers' share dealings (v2.3.0, plan B6; made a swappable pack in v2.4.0). None of these rules has yet been confirmed against the current official text. They are applied provisionally: every flag they raise is marked '(provisional rule)'. A flag is a fact to examine, not a finding of breach.
how_to_update: SWAPPABLE MODULE. This pack can be replaced without a new version of the program: 'ashare-cli rules-export insider' copies it to the data folder's rules folder for editing; 'ashare-cli rules-import insider FILE --apply' installs an edited copy after checking it (the pack it replaces is kept in rules/_replaced); 'ashare-cli rules-reset insider --apply' returns to the pack shipped with the program. The same actions are under Check > Rules. Set a rule's 'status' to 'confirmed' once its article, effective date and numbers have been checked against the official text, and record the check in 'verified'; 'withdrawn' keeps a rule without applying it.
